valid.describes: only the required fields, as an early publish emits them
the manifest already shipped for indiafoss-2025 still validates
an unknown optional field is tolerated, not rejected

invalid.describes: a newer major version is refused so the last good manifest survives
revision must be a positive integer
invalid.expectIssue: revision must be a positive integer

invalid.describes: a manifest pointing at nothing is not a publish
an asset name must not escape the published directory
generatedAt must parse as a timestamp

valid.describes: resolved room ids, session rooms and rehearsed capabilities

invalid.describes: two entries sharing an alias is the split-room failure this contract prevents
an alias without the # sigil is not resolvable
invalid.expectIssue: must be a Matrix room alias

invalid.describes: an unrecognised route would be silently ignored by a naive reader
an empty directory would leave every client to invent its own room
a roomId with the wrong sigil is a user id or an alias in the wrong field
invalid.expectIssue: must be a Matrix room id

valid.describes: a card with no profile and no accounts is still a valid card
a signed card claiming both a classic and a mesh account

invalid.describes: an account marked mesh must actually be an @n: identity
invalid.expectIssue: marked mesh but is not an @n: identity

invalid.describes: the same account claimed twice with different trust is ambiguous
a card that expired before it was issued cannot be reasoned about
a plain http link in a shared profile downgrades the reader
profile is required even when empty, so absence is never mistaken for consent
an unrecognised trust value must not be treated as a badge

valid.describes: a display-scope binding with no signatures yet
a routing-scope binding is structurally valid; acting on it still needs #188

invalid.describes: a truncated node id is the short code, which is a recognition aid not an identity
binding a mesh identity to itself carries no information
an unrecognised scope must not widen what the binding authorizes
an already-expired binding at issue time
node ids are lowercase hex; case drift would break equality checks

valid.describes: Companion opening one of its own sessions
Companion handing a mesh peer to Chat, with an explicit sending account
a room handoff by canonical alias

invalid.describes: a handoff must never carry credential material, however well-formed
an open-dm handoff pointing at a room would start a DM with nobody
invalid.expectIssue: must be a Matrix user id for open-dm

invalid.describes: an unrecognised action must not fall through to a default
an accountHint that is not a user id cannot select an account
invalid.expectIssue: accountHint must be a Matrix user id

valid.describes: a full release record, including a capability recorded as not working

invalid.describes: a branch name makes the record unreproducible the moment the branch moves
invalid.expectIssue: revision must be a commit sha

invalid.describes: a topology claim that does not say which topology proves nothing
invalid.expectIssue: topology is required when level is topology-tested

invalid.describes: a claim with no verdict would read as support by omission
a record with no claims is not evidence of anything
the same capability claimed twice with different verdicts is unresolvable
